sections.thesis: Fed funds futures now unanimously expect a rate hike in December after consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, the third straight month of outsized increases.

sentences.text: Fed funds futures now unanimously expect a rate hike in December after consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, the third straight month of outsized increases.
Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee called the report "borderline disturbing", and futures put the odds of a half-point move at 15%.
Those expectations sent the 10-year Treasury yield above 5% on Tuesday.

sections.thesis: The dollar index rose above 103.00, its highest since April 2025, as hot inflation data and hawkish Fed officials firmed bets on further hikes.

sentences.text: The dollar index rose above 103.00, its highest since April 2025, as hot inflation data and hawkish Fed officials firmed bets on further hikes.
The US-Iran standoff over the Strait of Hormuz also kept a risk premium supporting the dollar, with weekly jobless claims and Fed speeches next.

sections.thesis: US tech stocks jumped on Wednesday as better-than-expected CoreWeave results and a possibly higher Anthropic IPO valuation extended the rebound from last week's rout.

sentences.text: US tech stocks jumped on Wednesday as better-than-expected CoreWeave results and a possibly higher Anthropic IPO valuation extended the rebound from last week's rout.
The Nasdaq 100 rose 2.3% and the S&P 500 1.3%, with CoreWeave up 25%.
Nvidia then fell 8.6% after the close on reports its board was considering chief executive Jensen Huang's future, and the Nasdaq 100 was set to open 0.75% lower on Thursday.

sections.thesis: Brent rose nearly 3% on Wednesday as Iran denied it is negotiating with Washington, after losing about 21% since the start of November on bets the war was winding down.

sentences.text: Brent rose nearly 3% on Wednesday as Iran denied it is negotiating with Washington, after losing about 21% since the start of November on bets the war was winding down.
Middle Eastern crude exports are near pre-war levels, but transport costs have reached as much as $30 a barrel and refined product flows remain at 37% of normal.
